rationale: Exactly four authorizing delivery mutations (customer grant revocation, restrictive policy upsert, distribution withdrawal and active grant revocation) and one non-authorizing distribution event write moved from the shared delivery module to private legal authority. The owner independently reads the current grant, product, version, staff principal, permissions and prior distribution status; only negative withdrawal and tightening are accepted. No paid-access grant issuance, redemption or positive relaxation is authorized. All nine other delivery sites retain their exact SQL literal/function/disposition and full-file fingerprint-based site identity. No production routing, release gate or direct D1 privilege changes.

files.review: Verified each retained SQL statement text byte-for-byte against predecessor. Original five retired SQL fingerprints recorded in immutable audit lineage.
